links.outcome: LLM summary vs physician summary completeness and correctness against original pathology reports
links.effect: LLM summaries scored higher on all objective metrics (P<.0001) vs physician summaries; DeepSeek, Mistral, Llama 3.1, 3.2 rated more complete (P=.017, <.0001) with comparable correctness (P=1.000).
links.quote: Using the original pathology reports as the ground truth, the LLM-generated summaries achieved higher scores across all objective evaluation metrics compared with physician pathology summaries (P < .0001).

screen.reason: Evaluates the performance and accuracy of several open-source LLMs in summarizing cancer pathology reports using retrospective data compared to physician summaries, without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
